title: Universal Life Insurance Contract Data Page: Grace Period, No-Lapse Guarantee and Reinstatement Terms
content:
These are the per-tier contract terms of Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance for the grace period, the no-lapse guarantee and reinstatement.

## Contract terms

| Item | Lifetime Guarantee UL | Protection UL | Accumulation UL | Indexed UL Protect | Indexed UL Growth | Indexed UL Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grace period (calendar days from the monthly anniversary on which the deduction could not be covered) | 61 | 61 | 61 | 61 | 61 | 61 |
| Further months of monthly deductions the grace cure premium must also cover | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| No-lapse guarantee carried | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| How the end of the no-lapse guarantee is measured | To attained age | To attained age | Policy years | Policy years | Policy years | Policy years |
| Guarantee ends at | Attained age 121 | Attained age 90 | 10 policy years | 20 policy years | 10 policy years | 5 policy years |
| Failed guarantee may be restored by paying the shortfall within the guarantee period | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No | No |
| Reinstatement window (calendar months from the lapse date) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Further months of monthly deductions the reinstatement premium must cover | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |

## Reading the terms

- **Attained-age basis.** On the Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL the guarantee runs to the policy anniversary on or after attained age 121; on the Ashgrove Protection UL to the anniversary on or after attained age 90.
- **Policy-year basis.** On the Ashgrove Accumulation UL and Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth the guarantee runs for 10 policy years, on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect for 20 and on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier for 5.
- **Restoration.** Only the Lifetime Guarantee UL, Protection UL and Indexed UL Protect allow a failed guarantee to be restored by paying the shortfall within the guarantee period; on the other three tiers it cannot be restored.

## Hypothetical illustration

An Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier issued on 10 March 2021 carries its guarantee for 5 policy years, to the fifth policy anniversary on 10 March 2026; an Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect issued the same day carries it to the twentieth anniversary on 10 March 2041.
